In this video, we take a hands-on look at Qwen3.8 Flash Next, an experimental open-weight model that Qwen describes as a preview of the architecture that will underpin Qwen 4.

We test the model across a range of coding and multimodal tasks, including browser-based workflows, C++ game creation, Blender and Godot development, local Q4 testing, FPS generation, and 3D scene creation.
